summary: Fact: SIRI's FY25 10-K, accession 0000908937-26-000006, says gross federal NOL carryforwards were approximately $127 (as written, not rescaled) which are subject to Section 382 limitations. The filing does not use the phrase ownership change and states no annual dollar limit.
